name: Daniele Bianco
biography: is a system administrator and IT consultant. He began his professional career as a system administrator during his early years at university. His interest for centralized management and software integration in Open Source environments has focused his work on design and development of suitable R&D infrastructure. For the time being Daniele is working as a consultant for Italian astrophysics research institutes, involving support for the design, development and the administration of IT infrastructure. One of his hobbies has always been playing with hardware and recently he has been pointing his attention on in-car wireless and navigation systems. He's the resident Hardware Hacker for international consultancy Inverse Path Ltd. Daniele holds a Bachelor's degree in physics from University of Trieste.
